title: Two at the conveyor
brief:
Six parts arrive one after another: red, blue, red, blue… Both arms can reach the end of the conveyor.

The **left arm** puts the **red** parts in the left bin; the **right arm** puts the **blue** parts in the right bin. Each arm repeats: wait until `part_color` is its color, pick, drop in its bin, and go back to `ready` out of the other arm’s way.

Both arms work at the same time, so mind the shared pick spot.

predicates.label: 3 red parts in the left bin
3 blue parts in the right bin

hints: Use a Repeat 3 loop in each arm’s program. You don’t need “Wait for each other” here: the colors decide whose turn it is.
Send each arm back to `ready` right after it drops a part, so the pick spot is free for the other arm.
